name: myScheme
allowed_use: Manual discovery and link-out/reference subject to current terms; no automated scraping or copying without express written authorization.
notes: Obtain written authorization or an expressly permitted export/API before bulk ingestion.

name: National Portal of India - Government Schemes
allowed_use: Discover scheme categories and official administering authorities; follow links to primary source for detailed claims.
notes: Portal indicates its schemes data is sourced from myScheme; do not treat it as a separate license to bulk-copy that data.

name: Open Government Data Platform India
allowed_use: Use published datasets/APIs only after checking each resource's terms/license and provenance.
notes: Record resource ID, publisher, license, access date and API/export method for every imported dataset.

name: Local Government Directory
allowed_use: Canonical state/UT/district/locality identifiers if reuse terms permit.
notes: Use stable codes for geographic deduplication and applicability.

name: Press Information Bureau
allowed_use: Discover launches, changes, extensions and announcements; verify policy details against administering ministry guidelines.
notes: Press releases alone should not be the sole source for detailed eligibility when scheme guidelines exist.

name: PM-KISAN Scheme - beneficiary data catalogue
publisher: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
allowed_use: Candidate for supporting aggregate beneficiary statistics only, after resource-level license, attribution, access terms and data fields are checked.
intended_use: Supporting statistics and scheme discovery; not a source for individual eligibility decisions.
notes: Inspect individual resources in the catalogue. Do not treat beneficiary counts as full scheme eligibility, benefits, documents or application instructions.

name: National Social Assistance Programme - beneficiary abstracts
publisher: Ministry of Rural Development, Department of Rural Development
allowed_use: Candidate for supporting aggregate pension beneficiary statistics only, after resource-level license, attribution, access terms and data fields are checked.
intended_use: Supporting statistics and scheme discovery; not a source for individual eligibility decisions.
notes: Catalogue includes pension-scheme beneficiary abstracts. Verify the exact resource, reporting period and geographic coverage before use.
